title: Lead kills the heart, not the IQ — where its ~1.5M deaths land

provenance.definition: Of the ~1.5 million deaths the Global Burden of Disease attributes to lead exposure each year, roughly 94% are cardiovascular — not the lost-IQ story lead is usually filed under. A 2023 Lancet Planetary Health re-analysis put the toll ~6× higher than GBD-2019, at a US$6.0 trillion (6.9% of GDP) cost.
provenance.attribution: IHME Global Burden of Disease; Larsen & Sánchez-Triana 2023 (Lancet Planetary Health)
provenance.primarySource: GBD/IHME — link-only; charted and cited, not re-hosted.
